## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Verification

List the commands/tests actually run and their results. Distinguish deterministic tests, container qualification, and live model evaluation. Explain any checks not run.

## Risks and boundaries

Note changes to approval, credentials, sandboxing, budgets, persistence, or dependencies. Identify remaining limitations and update relevant documentation.

- [ ] No credentials, private repository content, or unredacted state/log files are included.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage, or the reason for omitting it is explained.
